stem.x: Which of the following is the clause that is inserted into blank [[A]] of the SQL statement in order to display the names of employees who work in the same department as any employee located in "New York"?

b.x: department_id IN (SELECT department_id FROM Departments WHERE location = 'New York');
department_id NOT IN (SELECT department_id FROM Departments WHERE location = 'New York');
